पुरुषों में सेक्स ड्राइव और स्पर्म क्वालिटी का संबंध

कम सेक्स ड्राइव (लिबिडो) स्पर्म क्वालिटी को सीधे प्रभावित नहीं करती, लेकिन कम संभोग से ओव्यूलेशन मिस हो सकता है। तनाव, धूम्रपान, मोटापा, टेस्टोस्टेरोन कम होने से लिबिडो और स्पर्म दोनों प्रभावित। व्यायाम, अच्छी डाइट (जिंक, विटामिन D), और तनाव कम करने से सुधार। पुरुष भी फर्टिलिटी जांच कराएं।

सेक्स के बाद कितनी देर लेटना चाहिए प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए?

सेक्स के बाद 10-20 मिनट लेटे रहना स्पर्म को सर्वाइव करने और गर्भाशय में जाने में मदद करता है। वैज्ञानिक रूप से जरूरी नहीं, लेकिन हानिरहित है। पैर ऊपर रखना या कुशन से हिप्स उठाना बेहतर। ज्यादा देर (1 घंटा+) की जरूरत नहीं। आरामदायक रहें—तनाव से बचें।

सेक्स पोजीशन जो गर्भधारण में मदद करती हैं

प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए कितनी बार सेक्स करना चाहिए?

जaldi प्रेग्नेंट होने के लिए महीने में 10-15 बार संभोग आदर्श है, खासकर फर्टाइल दिनों में हर 1-2 दिन। ज्यादा फ्रीक्वेंसी (रोजाना) स्पर्म काउंट कम कर सकती है, जबकि बहुत कम (हफ्ते में 1-2 बार) ओव्यूलेशन मिस हो सकता है। व्यस्त जीवनशैली में शेड्यूल बनाएं। सेक्स केवल प्रजनन के लिए नहीं, बल्कि बॉन्डिंग के लिए भी जरूरी है। तनाव कम रखें—यह फर्टिलिटी बढ़ाता है।

This is currently the lowest morphology live-birth case published in Indian literature and among the top 3 lowest globally with full genetic testing.
Exact Morphology Report (Strict Kruger)
•  Concentration: 28 million/ml
•  Progressive motility: 42%
•  Strict morphology: 0.6% (only 0–1% is usually considered “absolute teratozoospermia” – almost no normal forms)

Protocol Used – The “Zero to Hero” Protocol
1.  Micro-TESE not required (because count was decent)
2.  Double trigger + HGH + Testosterone priming for wife
3.  PICSI + ZyMōt (microfluidic chip) + IMSI (×15,000 magnification sperm selection)
4.  Time-lapse incubator (EmbryoScope+) with AI embryo selection (Life Whisperer AI score used)
5.  All 6 embryos sent for PGT-A (NGS 24-chromosome screening)
6.  ERA + EMMA/ALICE testing done → window shifted + chronic endometritis treated
Results (verified by hospital)
•  Eggs retrieved: 5
•  Mature (MII): 4
•  Fertilised (2PN): 4
•  Day-5 blastocysts: 3 (Grade 4AA, 5AB, 5BB)

• Men: reduced sperm count, poor motility, and increased sperm DNA fragmentation

What Should Your HCG Level Be After Embryo Transfer?

After your embryo transfer, the Beta-hCG blood test is the moment of truth. But what do those numbers actually mean? India's leading IVF specialist, Dr. Firuza Parikh, breaks it down clearly.

📊 Key hCG levels to know after embryo transfer:
🔹 Less than 5 mIU/mL → Negative for pregnancy
🔹 Greater than 20 mIU/mL → Positive — pregnancy likely
🔹 Day 12 after transfer → hCG above 86.8 IU/mL is a positive predictor
🔹 Day 14 after transfer → Above 200 mIU/mL suggests a continuing pregnancy
🔹 Above 600 mIU/mL on Day 14 → May indicate multiple pregnancy (twins)

→ hCG should double every 48 hours in early pregnancy
→ Levels are retested every 4th day until they reach 20,000 mIU/mL
→ Once 20,000 is reached, a transvaginal ultrasound is performed

→ Slow-rising or falling hCG may suggest ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage risk
→ Always consult your specialist — numbers alone don't tell the full story

Diagnosed with a bulky uterus and worried about your chances of conceiving? You're asking the right questions — and the answers may be more hopeful than you think.

A normal uterus measures approximately 7–8 cm long & 4 cm thick. When it enlarges beyond this due to an underlying condition, it's termed a "bulky uterus."

⚠️ Common causes of a bulky uterus:
🔴 Fibroids — Non-cancerous tumours causing heavy bleeding & pelvic pain
🔴 Adenomyosis — Uterine lining growing into uterine muscle
🔴 Endometrial Cancer — Causing postmenopausal or abnormal bleeding
🔴 Pyometra — Pus accumulation due to uterine infection

→ Heavy or prolonged periods
→ Pelvic heaviness or pressure
→ Backache & frequent urination
→ Pain during intercourse

Your uterine lining is the very foundation of a successful pregnancy. When it's too thin, even the best embryo may struggle to implant.

At FertilTree – Jaslok Hospital, Mumbai, our specialists diagnose and treat thin endometrium with precision — giving your IVF cycle the best possible environment to succeed.

📏 What is "thin" endometrium?
An ideal uterine lining is 8mm to 12mm thick. Below 8mm significantly reduces implantation chances.

⚠️ Signs you may have a thin endometrial lining:
🔴 Difficulty conceiving or repeated IVF failures
🔴 Light or scanty menstrual bleeding
🔴 Irregular or unusually short periods
🔴 History of miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy

→ Low estrogen levels
→ Decreased blood flow to the uterus
→ Uterine infections (including TB-related)
→ Previous D&C, surgery or Caesarean section

What is SSG? 🌸

SSG (Saline Sonohysterography) is a special ultrasound test where saline is gently used to clearly see the inside of the uterus.

SSG helps detect:
✅ Uterine polyps
✅ Fibroids
✅ Adhesions or scars
✅ Causes of infertility
✅ Causes of recurrent pregnancy loss

A clear and healthy uterine cavity can improve the chances of implantation and pregnancy. Early diagnosis helps your fertility specialist plan the right treatment at the right time. 💛

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we provide accurate fertility evaluation and personalized care for every couple’s parenthood journey.

When Should You Get an HSG Test? 🌸

An HSG (Hysterosalpingography) is a simple X-ray test that checks whether your fallopian tubes are open and evaluates the shape of your uterus. It is an important investigation for couples facing difficulty conceiving.

Your doctor may recommend an HSG if:
✅ You have been trying to conceive for 1 year without success (or 6 months if you are over 35)
✅ Pregnancy is not happening despite regular ovulation
✅ You are planning IUI treatment
✅ There is a suspicion of blocked fallopian tubes or unexplained infertility

Blocked fallopian tubes can prevent the egg and sperm from meeting, making natural conception difficult. Identifying the cause early helps your fertility specialist choose the most appropriate treatment.

💛 Early diagnosis leads to better fertility planning and improved chances of pregnancy.

What is Follicular Study? 🌸

Follicular study is a series of ultrasound scans done to track egg growth and identify the right time of ovulation.

It helps in:
✅ Knowing the exact ovulation day
✅ Tracking follicle/egg growth
✅ Timing intercourse or IUI correctly
✅ Improving chances of pregnancy

Right timing can make all the difference when you are trying to conceive. Follicular study helps identify your most fertile days and supports better fertility planning.

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we guide couples with accurate monitoring and personalized fertility care. 💛

What is Unexplained Infertility? 🤔🌸

Unexplained infertility means all common fertility reports may look normal, but pregnancy is still not happening.

Common tests may show normal:
✅ Ovulation
✅ Semen analysis
✅ Fallopian tubes
✅ Hormone levels

But sometimes, the cause may be hidden — like egg quality, sperm function, fertilization issues, implantation problems, or mild endometriosis.

The good news is: treatment options are available. 💛
With expert evaluation, personalized planning, and timely treatment, many couples can still achieve pregnancy.

Don’t lose hope. Consult a fertility specialist and take the next step toward parenthood. ✨

**Strategies to Improve Egg Quality and Number of Eggs**

Egg quality and egg number are crucial factors for successful conception, whether natural or through IVF. Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.
